## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] `go fmt ./...`, `go vet ./...`, and `go test ./...` pass
- [ ] Documentation updated where needed

## Safety and release impact

- [ ] This does not add or broaden an external write action
- [ ] Any new configuration is safe by default and documented
- [ ] I considered changelog/versioning impact

## Checklist

- [ ] No credentials, tokens, personal media paths, or generated databases are included
- [ ] Commits contain no agent/LLM attribution or co-author trailers
